scope: 0.30 m relative horizontal translation and +30 degree yaw SITL diagnostic, using the existing normalized-cost and PX4 safety gates. This is a controlled run-local filter experiment, not P5 navigation acceptance.

comparison.pair_scope: Same ROS domain 228, D435i calibration wall scene, 0.30 m horizontal/+30 degree yaw goal, flight harness, PX4 bridge overlay and safety gates; independent Gazebo partition and localization epoch for each run.
comparison.causal_attribution_limit: Separate SITL runs vary naturally in estimator initialization and image/residual samples; this comparison supports observed associations only.

setup.patch_chain: fixed project patches 0001-0005, run-local #181 timing, #203 0006 feature diagnostics, #206 0007 all-feature residual export; no #0008 anisotropy filter
setup.opt_in_environment: VINS_RUN_LOCAL_FEATURE_MIN_ANISOTROPY unset; #0008 filter not compiled into this binary
setup.world_qualification: Initialization calibration wall only; no runtime truth source or full world-map input.

build.own_overlay_build_result: passed in run-local bridge-install overlay; build log retained in the run directory.

filter.algorithm: For each current left feature, compute an 11x11 Sobel structure-tensor minimum/maximum eigenvalue ratio and retain only candidates with ratio >= the explicit run-local threshold; absent/invalid environment disables the filter.
filter.applied_in_tracker: left feature candidate selection only; diagnostic experiment is not canonical VINS behavior.

goal_configuration.qualification: PROVISIONAL vertical-motion ablation: preserve the #191 0.30 m horizontal and 30-degree yaw target, set vertical offset to zero; not a P5 scenario acceptance

px4_ulog.interpretation: ULog records EV position/yaw/velocity aiding, zero GNSS aiding flags, zero dropouts, touchdown and final disarm. Brief DESCEND/failsafe occurred after touchdown in this action-abort run; this is retained as a limitation, not a navigation success.

capture.annotation_runtime_effect: none; saved images were annotated offline in BGR format.

full_observation_analysis.method: Each residual observation is joined by target_stamp_ns and camera side to its captured mono image. For each image, the largest absolute vertical intensity gradient at each x within y=270..419 is fit with an ordinary least-squares line over x=10..629. Signed edge distance and residual projections onto the fitted line tangent and normal are computed. An 11x11 Sobel structure tensor at each target coordinate provides a local minimum-to-maximum eigenvalue ratio as a texture anisotropy descriptor.
full_observation_analysis.interpretation_limit: This correlates image-space residuals with a fitted high-gradient line, not a semantic wall/floor label. Rows repeat feature IDs across temporal/stereo blocks and are not independent samples. The relation does not distinguish tracking, calibration, motion-estimation, or texture causes.

interpretation.supported: The unfiltered paired control reproduced the low-anisotropy edge-aligned residual pattern: 34/34 blocks over 1.5 px lie within 1 px of the fitted high-gradient edge; their median local tensor ratio is 0.00156 and they contribute 99.36% of visual Huber cost. The action was aborted by the unchanged normalized-cost guard at 1.2530; ULog shows safe AUTO_LAND/touchdown/disarm, with brief post-touchdown DESCEND/failsafe.
not_established: whether this residual pattern is the sole cause of VIO position/yaw error
whether feature filtering improves navigation accuracy
interpretation.next_step: Use as the same-domain unfiltered control for #211–#213 filter observations; do not relax the 1.0 localization quality gate.

qualification.scope_limit: SITL only. This is an independent run-local filter observation on one calibration-wall scene; it does not establish navigation accuracy, generalization, or causality.
